Halloween night isn't over yet. Michael Myers manages to free himself from Laurie Strode's trap to resume his ritual bloodbath. As Laurie fights for her life after her last encounter with Michael, she inspires her daughter Karen, granddaughter Allyson, and all of Haddonfield to form a vigilante mob that sets out to hunt Michael down, once and for all.
